description.tr: Hadîs hafızı, edebiyata vâkıf, Hanbelî mezhebinin büyüklerinden.
description.en: A hadith scholar, versed in literature, among the major figures of the Ḥanbalī school.

transliteration.ar-Latn-x-alalc: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. ʿAbd al-Hādī b. ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd b. ʿAbd al-Hādī, Shams al-Dīn, Abū ʿAbd Allāh, Ibn Qudāma al-Muqaddisī al-Jimāʿīlī al-aṣl, then al-Dimashqī al-Ṣāliḥī

tr: Muhammed b. Ahmed b. Abdilhâdî b. Abdilhamîd b. Abdilhâdî, Şemseddîn, Ebû Abdillah, İbn Kudâme el-Mukaddisî el-Cimâilîlî el-asıl, sonra ed-Dımaşkî es-Sâlihî
ar: محمد بن أحمد بن عبد الهادي بن عبد الحميد بن عبد الهادي، شمس الدين، أبوعبد الله، ابن قدامة المقدسي الجماعيلي الأصل، ثم الدمشقي الصالحي

derived_from.edition_or_version: Khayr al-Dīn al-Ziriklī, al-Aʿlām (Beirut: Dār al-ʿIlm li’l-Malāyīn, 8th ed. 2002), 8 vols.
